title: ATV Training Session & Guided Tour Combo
includes: There will be up to a 1 hour check-in period followed by up to 3 hours of training and riding
No deposits. We hold your ID and credit/debit card during your rental (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
All guests must speak and understand English
All minors must be accompanied by a parent
Must be 16+ with a valid ID to participate
Must be at least 18+ with a valid ID and credit or debit card to book
This option is for single-passenger ATVs for ages 16+.
policies: A signed waiver will be required in order to participate
No skirts or dresses, no open toed shoes
For the best experience we recommend booking the early morning tour times, temps are cooler and group sizes are smaller
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a great option for beginners wanting to experience our most adventurous ATV Tour! This is a combination of our beginner-friendly "ATV Training Session" and our adventurous "Centipede ATV Tour." Your ATV Training includes a safety operations briefing and some riding on our awesome test course, known as "The Sidewinder." The Sidewinder is full of turns, bumps, and hills that will help you go from beginner to expert! Once training is complete you will embark on Arizona's most adventurous tour! The Centipede ATV Tour will take you deep into the Sonoran Desert, through deep canyons and over mountains to create a once-in-a-lifetime experience. With breathtaking views of the Bradshaw mountains and abundant wildlife, there is something for everyone! You’ll be accompanied by a certified guide with a vast knowledge of the area.

This option is for single-passenger ATVs for ages 16+. To book multi-passenger vehicles, search for our "Centipede Tour - Guided Arizona Desert Tour by UTV."
